name: bifrost-cost-rpm
description: Test 3 on Bifrost transports/v2.2.6, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway key (limits in the run's NOTE.md and quota.json). A request limit of 3 a minute. Bifrost checks usage >= limit before each call and counts a request only after it succeeds, so expect 3 answered, then 429 with no model call, then answered again once the minute has passed (resets are swept every 10 s).
